figs.name: engineering-formulas-hydrostatic-pressure-level-diagram
figs.alt: engineering formulas for hydrostatic pressure and DP transmitter tank level measurement
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing P = ρgh on an open water tank with a DP transmitter, worked for a 5 m water column of about 150 kPa absolute.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 550" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Hydrostatic pressure and DP level measurement on an open water tank</title>
<rect width="800" height="550" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Hydrostatic Pressure and DP Level</text>
<rect x="70" y="80" width="230" height="330" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="72" y="160" width="226" height="248" fill="#dbeafe"/>
<line x1="72" y1="160" x2="298" y2="160" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="185" y="140" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Open top tank</text>
<line x1="330" y1="285" x2="330" y2="163" stroke="#92400e" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="330" y1="285" x2="330" y2="405" stroke="#92400e" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="352" y="292" font-size="22" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">h</text>
<line x1="300" y1="395" x2="400" y2="395" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="4"/>
<rect x="400" y="360" width="150" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="475.0" y="389.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DP transmitter</text>
<text x="475.0" y="412.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">HP side</text>
<text x="475" y="455" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">LP side open</text>
<text x="475" y="478" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">to atmosphere</text>
<text x="185" y="300" font-size="20" fill="#1d4ed8" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Water</text>
<text x="185" y="325" font-size="18" fill="#1d4ed8" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ρ = 1000 kg/m³</text>
<rect x="575" y="80" width="200" height="350" rx="12" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="675" y="115" font-size="20" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">P = ρ × g × h</text>
<text x="675" y="150" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">h = P / (ρ × g)</text>
<text x="675" y="195" font-size="18" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example</text>
<text x="675" y="222" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">h = 5 m water</text>
<text x="675" y="249" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1000 × 9.81 × 5</text>
<text x="675" y="276" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= 49 kPa gauge</text>
<text x="675" y="303" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">+ 101.3 kPa atm</text>
<text x="675" y="330" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">≈ 150 kPa abs</text>
<text x="675" y="375" font-size="18" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Rule of thumb</text>
<text x="675" y="402" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">10 m water ≈ 1 bar</text>
<text x="400" y="530" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Absolute pressure = gauge pressure + atmospheric pressure</text>
</svg>

figs.name: engineering-formulas-reynolds-number-flowchart
figs.alt: Reynolds number flowchart for laminar, transitional and turbulent flow in pipes
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to calculate the Reynolds number and classify pipe flow as laminar below 2000, transitional, or turbulent above 4000.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Reynolds number flowchart to classify laminar, transitional and turbulent pipe flow</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reynolds Number: Which Flow Regime?</text>
<rect x="250" y="60" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="89.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Collect data</text>
<text x="400.0" y="112.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ρ, velocity v, pipe D, viscosity μ</text>
<line x1="400" y1="130" x2="400" y2="160" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="250" y="162" width="300" height="62" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="187.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Calculate</text>
<text x="400.0" y="211.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Re = ρ × v × D / μ</text>
<line x1="400" y1="224" x2="400" y2="250" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,250.0 515.0,300 400,350.0 285.0,300" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="306.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Re < 2000?</text>
<line x1="515" y1="300" x2="575" y2="300" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="545" y="290" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="578" y="260" width="195" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#047857" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="675.5" y="282.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Laminar</text>
<text x="675.5" y="305.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Hagen Poiseuille</text>
<text x="675.5" y="328.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">law is valid</text>
<line x1="400" y1="350" x2="400" y2="380" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="372" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="400,380.0 515.0,430 400,480.0 285.0,430" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="436.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Re > 4000?</text>
<line x1="515" y1="430" x2="575" y2="430" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="545" y="420" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="578" y="395" width="195" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="675.5" y="424.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Turbulent</text>
<text x="675.5" y="447.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">typical in pipes</text>
<line x1="285" y1="430" x2="225" y2="430" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="255" y="420" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="30" y="395" width="195" height="70" rx="10" fill="#eef6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="127.5" y="424.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Transitional</text>
<text x="127.5" y="447.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">2000 to 4000</text>
<text x="400" y="530" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Then use Darcy Weisbach for friction head loss in the pipe</text>
</svg>

figs.name: engineering-formulas-electrical-formula-infographic
figs.alt: electrical engineering formulas card with Ohm law, power, reactance and three phase power
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog summarising key electrical formulas for instrumentation: Ohm law, power, energy, reactance, frequency and three phase power.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Electrical engineering formulas card for instrumentation</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Electrical Formulas at a Glance</text>
<rect x="30" y="70" width="236" height="180" rx="14" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="30" y="70" width="236" height="46" rx="14" fill="#b45309"/><rect x="30" y="100" width="236" height="16" fill="#b45309"/>
<text x="148" y="101" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ohm law</text>
<text x="148" y="170" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">V = I × R</text>
<text x="148" y="210" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">20 mA × 250 Ω = 5 V</text>
<rect x="282" y="70" width="236" height="180" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="282" y="70" width="236" height="46" rx="14" fill="#b45309"/><rect x="282" y="100" width="236" height="16" fill="#b45309"/>
<text x="400" y="101" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Power</text>
<text x="400" y="170" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">P = V × I = I² × R</text>
<text x="400" y="210" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">P = V² / R</text>
<rect x="534" y="70" width="236" height="180" rx="14" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="534" y="70" width="236" height="46" rx="14" fill="#b45309"/><rect x="534" y="100" width="236" height="16" fill="#b45309"/>
<text x="652" y="101" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Energy</text>
<text x="652" y="170" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">E = P × t</text>
<text x="652" y="210" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">measured in kWh</text>
<rect x="30" y="270" width="236" height="180" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="30" y="270" width="236" height="46" rx="14" fill="#b45309"/><rect x="30" y="300" width="236" height="16" fill="#b45309"/>
<text x="148" y="301" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reactance</text>
<text x="148" y="370" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">XL = 2πfL</text>
<text x="148" y="410" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">XC = 1 / (2πfC)</text>
<rect x="282" y="270" width="236" height="180" rx="14" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="282" y="270" width="236" height="46" rx="14" fill="#b45309"/><rect x="282" y="300" width="236" height="16" fill="#b45309"/>
<text x="400" y="301" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Frequency</text>
<text x="400" y="370" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">f = 1 / T</text>
<text x="400" y="410" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">50 Hz gives T = 20 ms</text>
<rect x="534" y="270" width="236" height="180" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="534" y="270" width="236" height="46" rx="14" fill="#b45309"/><rect x="534" y="300" width="236" height="16" fill="#b45309"/>
<text x="652" y="301" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Three phase</text>
<text x="652" y="370" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">P = √3 VL IL cos φ</text>
<text x="652" y="410" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">motors and drives</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Transformer: Vp / Vs = Np / Ns, the basis of CTs and PTs</text>
</svg>
